messages:
Maya: FYI noticed a p95 jump during the 11:20 UTC microburst run, looks correlated with small-microbatch decode + KV cold hits. attaching profiler link: https://perf.internal/runs/2025-06-05/77
Alex: quick summary from flame: prefill median=28ms, prefill p95=160ms (KV sync reads), decode median=10ms, decode p95=180-220ms on some short-paths
Sanjay: interesting — kernel selector falls back to the slower path when microbatch_size < 4 for many layer shapes on A100. last week's kernel tuning changed some layer-shape thresholds and we probably widened fallback region
Ivy: do we have per-layer breakdown? maybe fallback is legit for some layers but not small-seq traffic. can we use seq_len as a signal, not just microbatch size?
Ruth: KV: when prefix cache misses we perform sync S3 reads inside prefill, adding ~40-80ms. for microbursts that doubles p95 when combined with fallback decode
Maya: log snippet from canary:
```
[2025-06-05T11:20:12Z] req=0x9a seq=24 microbatch=2 layer=transformer_11 kernel=fallback decode_ms=198 kv_prefill_block=true
[2025-06-05T11:20:12Z] req=0x9b seq=256 microbatch=16 layer=transformer_11 kernel=fast_gemm decode_ms=14 kv_prefill_block=false
```
Alex: so two orthogonal vectors: kernel path choice + synchronous KV prefill. either can push p95 above SLO, together they blow it out
Sanjay: prioritization: kernel heuristic fix first (fastest impact). plan: revert the recent threshold tweak -> set microbatch_fallback_threshold back to 3, add per-model override and per-layer short-seq opt-in. then measure
Ivy: longer-term: implement seq_len_weighted_kernel_selection: score = alpha*microbatch + beta*(seq_len_bucket) + gamma*layer_shape_score. alpha/beta tunable per-model
Ruth: KV mitigation: change small-context prefill to async-with-timeout: kick off async read and continue decode if it isn't ready within X ms, then merge tokens when available. Also add opportunity to prewarm KV on recent request ids (LRU of hot prefixes)
Alex: metrics to add before canary: decode.kernel_path_counter (by layer & seq_len bucket), kv.prefill_sync_rate, kv.prefill_latency_p95, decode.total_p95_by_path. will also tag runs by canary flag
Maya: can we A/B 10% traffic with kernel revert? if p95 improves >=15% we expand. KV async prototype after we see kernel delta
Sanjay: I'll open PR to revert threshold + add per-model toggle and a canary flag. will include perf-run instruction and histogram by seq_len
Ivy: I'll spike seq_len_weighted selector and bench a few models locally (llama-2-13b, redwood-1-small) and post numbers by EOD
Ruth: I'll prototype async prefill timeout + metrics for kv.prefill_sync_rate. bench on canary infra to check impact on throughput
Alex: perf-bot queued perf-run: run_id=20250605-kw1, canary=10%, expected ~2h
perf-bot: perf-run queued: run_id=20250605-kw1, canary_traffic=10%, eta=2h, notif_on_complete=true
Maya: action list:
- Sanjay: PR revert + canary config (due today EOD)
- Alex: add decode/kernel metrics + dashboards (tomorrow)
- Ivy: seq_len-weighted selector spike (EOD)
- Ruth: async KV prefill spike + bench (Fri)
Maya: keep thread tight. log PR number here when open and include observed p95/p99 deltas. we'll iterate after the canary results. :memo:
